note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3409 VARIABLE LABELS (identical in 3409.sav) P7_1 'Con el pueblo o ciudad donde vive', P7_2 'Con la Comunidad autónoma donde vive', P7_3 'Con España', P7_4 'Con Europa', P7_5 'Con la humanidad en su conjunto'; VALUE LABELS identical on all five: 0 '0 Nada identificado/a', 10 '10 Muy identificado/a', 98 'N.S.', 99 'N.C.' (1..9 carry no label). The same five units appear in the same order as the rows of the [P7] grid in cues3409.pdf; codigo3409.pdf lists P7 as P7_1..P7_5 'Escala de identificación (1-10) con diferentes ámbitos territoriales' (the codebook says 1-10; the questionnaire, value labels and data all run 0-10). DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do imports 3409_num.csv, runs 'rename *, lower' and in Bookmark 2 loops gen item = the literal names p7_1..p7_5, so the item code IS the CIS column name lowercased; nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: re-running the .do logic on 3409_num.csv (id = row number; 98/99 to missing; no other recode) reproduces the live table exactly -- 38074 rows, id-item-resp row sets identical (0/0 set differences) against the local irw cache copy made by table_context.R (no additional export). Per-item n p7_1..p7_5 = 7640/7636/7631/7596/7571, identical to irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) and all distinct, so n alone separates the items; item x resp cells also match at all 11 levels (e.g. resp 10: 2121/2358/2852/1673/2439; resp 0: 110/154/197/217/158). Route 8 coherence: Europe (p7_4) has the lowest mean (7.3 vs 7.6-7.8) and the smallest top-box count, and Spain (p7_3) the largest top box (2852). Dropped codes: 98 N.S. 2/5/8/35/52 and 99 N.C. 1/2/4/12/20 of 7643. text_source=study_materials: Spanish transcribed from cues3409.pdf (pdftotext -layout and -raw agree). item_text = the grid row labels; they match the .sav variable labels except that the questionnaire capitalises 'Comunidad Autónoma' (shipped as printed). instructions = the P.7 lead sentence plus both question sentences verbatim, including the questionnaire's own 'con....' (four dots) and the blank '___________' in the repeat question; the interviewer direction '(ENTREVISTADOR/A: REPETIR LA PREGUNTA PARA CADA ÁMBITO GEOGRÁFICO Y RECORDAR LA ESCALA DE RESPUESTA)' is not addressed to the respondent and is not shipped. The first question sentence embeds item 1 ('el pueblo o ciudad donde vive') because that is how the questionnaire opens P.7; kept as printed. section_prompt blank, one trivial section_id: P.7 is a single flat grid. PIPED TEXT, deliberate deviation from the sibling convention: the P7_2 row prints a CATI fill '(@1@2...@19)' after 'Con la Comunidad Autónoma donde vive'. This is not the 20-token demonym fill used in P.8/P.12/P.13 (for which CIS publishes the placeholder '(gentilicio de la C. A.)'); it has 19 tokens, sits in parentheses after a noun phrase, and grammatically inserts the community's NAME, for which CIS publishes no placeholder. Using '(gentilicio de la C. A.)' here would assert a demonym the respondent did not hear, so the fill is omitted, exactly as CIS's own P7_2 variable label omits it; disclosed in public_note. No respondent's actual region is shown. RESP: CIS codes 0..10 stored unchanged; option_text shipped for 0 'Nada identificado/a' and 10 'Muy identificado/a' only (the grid's end-point labels, matching the .sav value labels with their leading digit stripped); 1..9 carry no verbal label in the source and are left blank, not padded. Every item uses all eleven levels and carries eleven option rows. 98/99 have no option row. resp 10 = strongest identification. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3409 in Spanish only; the four _translated columns were written by IRW. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Identification with territorial units from the local municipality up to Spain, Europe, and humanity as a whole' matches P7_1..P7_5 exactly; no instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS: md3409 also covers spain_2023_identity_state (in progress by another batch_356 agent) and the batch_354/355 tables; none of their files were touched; the zip was copied into .cache/spain_2023_identity_territorial/ and md5-checked. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, scope every CIS study any year, irw#2381). Originator of the wording is CIS itself.
